data.title: Offer accepted followed by delayed start date or post-signing revocation
data.content:
# Offer accepted followed by delayed start date or post-signing revocation

A signed offer is met with repeated start-date delays, pre-day-one communication freezes, or sudden revocation during early onboarding.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not establish that the candidate's performance or background check caused the delay.
- Does not establish that the role was fraudulent when the offer was originally issued.
data.summary: A signed offer is met with repeated start-date delays, pre-day-one communication freezes, or sudden revocation during early onboarding.

probes.action: Request written confirmation of the revised start date alongside written clarification of whether hardware shipment and payroll registration remain active.
probes.expected_signal: Separates an administrative IT delay from a structural hiring freeze or pre-start headcount cancellation.

outcomes.label: The employer confirms the date with tracking details for onboarding equipment.
outcomes.because: Active equipment dispatch and a confirmed date weigh against a current freeze or revocation, but do not make a later change impossible.

outcomes.label: The employer provides vague holding notices without committing to a fixed onboarding date.
outcomes.because: Repeated holding notices without a date weigh against a routine administrative delay with a settled onboarding plan.

outcomes.label: The employer confirms headcount revocation or indefinite pause prior to start date.
outcomes.because: A confirmed headcount cancellation makes candidate-performance explanations less plausible for the pre-start outcome.

specimens.label: Post-acceptance start date slippage
specimens.subject: Update on your upcoming start date

lines.text: We are excited to welcome you next Monday!
Due to internal team restructuring, we need to push your start date by three weeks.
We are still finalizing leadership approvals for the revised onboarding date.

specimens.reading: The delay occurs after the candidate has resigned from previous employment, shifting contractual risk entirely onto the worker.

perspectives.sees: A confirmed start date deferred after notice was given to a prior employer, leaving their career runway exposed.
perspectives.reads: Start-date slippage signals unbudgeted headcount risk or an unannounced internal hiring pause.
perspectives.does: Requests clear written documentation of employment status and assesses legal and search alternatives.

perspectives.sees: An onboarding ticket blocked by finance or department leadership pending quarterly budget reconciliation.
perspectives.reads: The offer was extended under previous headcount assumptions that changed before start day.
perspectives.does: Relays holding messages while awaiting confirmation on whether the placement can proceed.

perspectives.sees: Quarterly headcount adjustments or project scope revisions occurring between offer acceptance and payroll commencement.
perspectives.reads: Pushing start dates preserves budget flexibility before formal employment liability attaches.
perspectives.does: Enforces hiring pauses across pending pipeline offers where commercial conditions shift.

non_inferences: Does not establish that the candidate's performance or background check caused the delay.
Does not establish that the role was fraudulent when the offer was originally issued.
